title: Copy dashboard tile
description: Copy an insight, text card, or widget tile from one dashboard to another. The path dashboard ID is the destination. Provide fromDashboardId (source dashboard) and tileId (tile to copy). Widget tiles require the dashboard-widgets feature flag and are deep-cloned with a new widget row.

methodDocumentation.text: Copy an existing dashboard tile to another dashboard (insight, text card, or widget tile).

Copy an insight, text card, or widget tile from one dashboard to another. The path dashboard ID is the destination. Provide fromDashboardId (source dashboard) and tileId (tile to copy). Widget tiles require the dashboard-widgets feature flag and are deep-cloned with a new widget row.
